insight: Trust and reputation outcomes depend on monitoring cadence, observation cost, and evidence-transfer friction, not just on action policy.
Helping worlds need explicit willingness-versus-ability and need-versus-burden semantics, or they can reward victim-blame and punish incapacity as if it were bad intent.
recommended_next_build: One trust/reputation lane with explicit monitoring cost, cadence, and evidence-transfer friction plus a low-friction baseline.
One helping or partner-choice lane that separates willingness from ability and publishes recipient need/burden metadata before interpreting refusal or exclusion.
